mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, p.id AS paymentId, os.code AS orderStatus, ps.code AS paymentStatus, pm.code AS paymentMethod, p.amount AS approvedAmount FROM orders o JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id JOIN common_code os ON os.id = o.status_id JOIN common_code ps ON ps.id = p.status_id JOIN common_code pm ON pm.id = p.method_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND ps.code = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_refund ( payment_id, amount, reason, refunded_at, provider_cancel_transaction_key ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{amount}, #{refundReason}, #{refundedAt}, #{cancelTransactionKey} )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status_id = #{canceledStatusId}, canceled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status_id != #{canceledStatusId}
